_comment_TaskName: CUSTOMIZE: Choose an unused scheduled task name.
_comment_TaskPath: CUSTOMIZE: Choose an existing Task Scheduler folder, with leading and trailing backslashes.
_comment_InstallRoot: CUSTOMIZE: Choose a new dedicated directory outside the Windows directory, under an existing trusted parent.
_comment_ScriptName: CUSTOMIZE: Choose the installed script filename.
_comment_LogName: CUSTOMIZE: Choose the log filename inside InstallRoot.
_comment_DailyAt: CUSTOMIZE: Set the daily local time in 24-hour HH:mm format.
_comment_StartupDelaySeconds: CUSTOMIZE: Set the delay after startup, from 1 to 3600 seconds.
_comment_VerificationTimeoutSeconds: CUSTOMIZE: Set how long installation waits for the first task run, from 10 to 3600 seconds.
_comment_ReagentcPath: CUSTOMIZE: Confirm the full path to the Windows recovery utility.
_comment_PowerShellPath: CUSTOMIZE: Confirm the full path to the 64-bit Windows PowerShell executable used by the task.
